topic.source_contract: plan scope, screening, scoping, baseline, reasonable alternatives, effects, mitigation, consultation, adoption and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A screening opinion is not treated as a completed environmental report.
A scoping report is not treated as appraisal of reasonable alternatives.
A preferred option is not treated as the only reasonable alternative.
Consultation is not treated as plan adoption.
An environmental report is not treated as proof that significant effects are avoided.
Mitigation proposed in appraisal is not treated as secured implementation.
Plan adoption is not treated as monitored environmental performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact plan, alternatives, consultation, adoption, mitigation and monitoring evidence.
row_checks: Local plan, spatial strategy, neighbourhood plan or programme required
Environment Agency, Natural England and Historic England roles required
Current environmental, social and economic baseline required
Reasons for selecting and rejecting alternatives required
Direct, indirect and cumulative effects required
Short, medium and long-term effects required
Avoidance, reduction and compensation measures required
Required report contents and non-technical summary required
Final decision and alternatives reasoning required
Significant effects and remedial action framework required
Map, policy or strategy alone is not exact-site delivery
Application or proposal is not approval
Funding announcement is not completed delivery
Current operational use or service required
